Body.Content:
We identified that changes made in relation to the retirement of SharePoint temporary authentication URLs communicated under MC1551122 may prevent thumbnails for SharePoint items from rendering in Power Apps.

How does this affect me?
SharePoint thumbnails displayed in your apps may not render. Other app functionality is not as affected.

What action do I need to take?
To restore missing SharePoint thumbnails, republish the affected app. After the app is republished, users who start or restart it should see thumbnails render correctly within one hour. If your SharePoint thumbnails are rendering in Power Apps as expected, no action is required.

message.Title: Power Apps - Information about SharePoint thumbnails not rendering
